Name: More Bottles and Cans
Author: BadMoonBeast
Description:
[i]Hey all, I made this as sort of a companion for my [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6522]Milk Bottles and Cans mod[/url][i]. It drives me nuts shipping or running around with open cups. Some of the others were just to make the sprite more visually intuitive for my brain.[/i]

[b]Includes Sprite Replacements For:[/b]
[list]
[*]Joja Cola
[*]Beer
[*]Pale Ale
[*]Cranberry Candy
[*]Green Tea
[*]Coffee
[*]Triple Shot Espresso (two options!)
[*]Energy Tonic
[*]Muscle Remedy
[*]Oil
[/list]
You can turn each one on or off as you please with the config (will generate on first load, or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]).

[b]Issues:
[/b][i]Please let me know if you find any![/i]

[b]Please note[/b] that you will require [b]both[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order for this mod to work.

Manifest.Name: More Bottles & Cans
Manifest.Description: Replaces various drink graphics with bottles and cans.
Manifest.Author: BadMoonBeast
